physical_contract.domain: First order weak homogeneous Bianchi I with fixed principal axes; B symmetric trace-free dimensionless. Comoving emitter and observer, outward source direction n, nonrotating orthonormal observer tetrad. Signature (-,+,+,+). t is observer/source cosmic proper time, not conformal time.
physical_contract.distance: chi=c integral_ts^to dt/a(t), D=a_o chi>0. Inputs explicitly provide B_s, B_o, dot B_o, D; no redshift-to-distance or dynamics inferred. Keep c=299792.458 km/s for physical units, or explicitly c=1 in dimensionless test units.
physical_contract.response: A=2*c*(B_o-B_s)/D-dot B_o; mu3=(I-n n^T) A n. e_alpha=(-sin alpha,cos alpha,0); e_delta=(-sin delta cos alpha,-sin delta sin alpha,cos delta); output (e_alpha.mu3,e_delta.mu3) is (mu_alpha*cos delta,mu_delta).
physical_contract.full5_basis: E1=diag(1,-1,0)/sqrt2; E2=diag(1,1,-2)/sqrt6; E3=(xy+yx)/sqrt2; E4=(xz+zx)/sqrt2; E5=(yz+zy)/sqrt2. Frobenius orthonormal. Retain signed full5 tensor coefficients and full covariance before optional norm.
physical_contract.units: B dimensionless, sigma=dot B inverse seconds; A inverse seconds. Convert rad/s to microarcsec/year using exactly 365.25*86400 seconds per Julian year and 180/pi*3600*1e6 microarcsec/radian. Selected-noise information is parameterized in full5 A coefficients microarcsec/year, covariance (microarcsec/year)^2.
physical_contract.near_limit: B_o-B_s=sigma_o Delta_t+O(Delta_t^2), D=c Delta_t+O(Delta_t^2) gives +P sigma_o n. Independent normalized affine separation derivative dot n=P sigma n fixes the sign.
physical_contract.distant_limit: For bounded fixed endpoint difference with 2c||B_o-B_s||/D negligible compared to ||sigma_o||, A approaches -sigma_o as D grows. Distant redshift alone does not establish this premise. Local-affine and distant examples describe different conditional histories.
physical_contract.history_bound: For Delta_t>0 and sup_ts^to||dot sigma||F<=L_sigma, ||A-sigma_o||F <= 2*abs(c*Delta_t/D-1)*||sigma_o||F+c*L_sigma*Delta_t^2/D. Bound input must be nonnegative finite; it is not estimated from the PM sample.
physical_contract.endpoint_witness: delta B=epsilon*tau*(1-tau)*T, tau=(t-ts)/Delta_t, epsilon=1e-4, Delta_t=2, ||T||F=1. Endpoints zero, delta dot B_o=-epsilon*T/Delta_t, delta A=+epsilon*T/Delta_t. Sphere PM RMS=epsilon/(Delta_t sqrt5)=2.2360679774997898e-5. Kinematic polynomial only.
physical_contract.sphere_identity: mean_sphere||P A n||^2=||A||F^2/5; P A n=grad_S(0.5 n^T A n), pure electric ell2 for a common A. Spin omega cross n is magnetic ell1; glide P g is electric ell1. Selected weighted sky does not preserve their full-sphere orthogonality.

Solve/derive the constant 5x5 transform M with D_STF=VSH_E2 M. Verify on a separate deterministic grid before embedding J in102 coordinates (only18:23=M). source_information.primary_nuisance: Six common spin/glide coefficients. N in102 coordinates sums matching E1/B1 axis columns from all3 disjoint bins. Form joint Gram for J5 and N6 with all cross terms. Report unprofiled and projected information, joint rank, nuisance rank, full5 covariance, J-N cross block, leakage/canonical angles and eigenvectors/eigenvalues.
source_information.prespecified_robustness: Repeat algebra on same G with all97 original non-E2 columns as unpenalized nuisance (all0:18 and23:102). This is a specified sensitivity comparison, not additional independent data. Report full cross covariance where the joint model has rank. Never import the old priors or use E2 as both signal and unlabelled nuisance.
source_information.degeneracy_falsifier: Add all5 E2 columns to nuisance; projected signal image must be zero and rank0 relative to original unprojected scale. A projected tiny residual may not be column-normalized to counterfeit rank. Common B1 signal is annihilated by free common spin; verify independently.
source_information.operator: Given Gram G=X^T V^-1 X, construct a PSD factor Q with Q^T Q=G and profile via orthogonal SVD projection of QN, or equivalent stable Schur complement with independently checked synthetic control. I=J^T G J-J^T G N*(N^T G N)^+*N^T G J. No jitter. Keep source/noise as measured marginal2x2 blocks under stipulated cross-source independence. Unknown spatial covariance stays UNKNOWN; no physical calibrated likelihood or selection coverage.
source_information.history_image: For a common effective distance D and declared T_ref>0, let q=(B_o-B_s)/T_ref and s=dot B_o, expressed in same rate units. Full10 endpoint-difference/derivative parameter image is A=k q-s with k=2c T_ref/D. R=[k I5,-I5], I_history=R^T I_A R has rank<=5; export full10x10 cross-block information, image and null directions delta s=k delta q. Separate B_o/B_s adds a common-endpoint null direction. This is a conditional common-distance image, not catalogue depth recovery.
source_information.depth_ceiling: Cached common E2 sufficient statistics do not support arbitrary per-row distance/depth E2 responses. Do not invent missing cross moments, assign reported z as true distance, or assert separation of endpoint and derivative histories from this single-profile product. A future depth law plus its cross-covariance permits a new response image.

finite_power_frontier.law: Stipulated fixed-design Gaussian working covariance only. Use projected5D A information rank r, alpha=0.05 chi-square_r threshold and noncentral chi-square power with lambda=a^T I a. No fit or empirical p-value is required.
finite_power_frontier.report: At full5 Frobenius radius rho, report best/worst orientation noncentrality rho^2 lambda_max/min(I), power and full eigenbasis. Solve lambda80 for80percent power then give best/worst rho80=sqrt(lambda80/eigenvalue). Rank-deficient worst direction has no finite threshold; do not use a pseudo-inverse to claim it bounded. Also report sphere RMS=rho/sqrt5.
finite_power_frontier.conditional_history_examples: Report k=0,0.1,1,2,10 in the full10 map R. k=0 denotes distant fixed-endpoint limit. For q=s with T_ref=Delta_t, gains are k-1, with k=2 local affine, k=1 exact cancellation, k=0 distant negative sign. Clearly label this fixed history family; power depends on gain squared while direction sign remains observable in the forward field. Cancellation does not imply no PM in other histories.
finite_power_frontier.physical_limits: Do not impose old CF4-scale amplitudes or vector CMB bounds as universal tensor bounds. Any chosen radius is a design variable. No optical-centroid-to-matter transfer, NNR likelihood, empirical cross-source covariance or physical depth law has been supplied.
